Subject: Finalist: closure pulse-check and tie-break ask for Priya N.

Hi team — quick pulse on Priya (SWE, backend infra). We have to close this loop today so recruiting can extend an offer by EOD tomorrow. TL;DR: please drop your filled scorecard and a one-line recommendation (hire / no-hire / hold) + any blocking concerns.

I've attached the panel scorecard and the work-sample notes I took during the coding interview. If you can, fill the scorecard directly and return it inline or as an attachment. Key things to call out: system design depth, debugging under pressure, and cross-team communication.

If you're a late voter and can't meet the full writeup, please at least reply with a one-line vote + a single-sentence rationale. If we end up 2x2 (tie), I'll assign a tiebreak owner — please nominate if you feel strongly.

Thanks — Vivek

Highlights (one-liners):
- System design: strong tradeoffs for cache invalidation and stateful shards. Good awareness of paging and cold-starts.
- Coding: clean implementation; minor bug in edge-case but fixed on the follow-up.
- Collaboration: asked good clarifying questions, prioritized shipping.

Blocking concerns: none besides wanting a follow-up on ownership transition plan for cross-team infra work.

Thanks all — summary and next steps:

Panel votes (collected): Marissa = HIRE; Kimberly = HOLD (lean HIRE); Neha = NO-HIRE.

Because votes are split, we need a tiebreak/decision owner. Two options: 1) Convene a 15-min sync (I can host at 4:30pm PT) to discuss specifics, or 2) assign a tiebreak owner to make a call based on the scorecards and follow-up questions. If you prefer 2, reply with your tiebreak nomination. If you prefer 1, reply "SYNC" and I'll schedule.

Recruiting has asked that we finalise by tomorrow 10am PT. If no response by 5:30pm PT, I will assign the tiebreak to Marissa (given her full HIRE vote and owning rollout for related infra).

Also: Neha — appreciate the quick note, please send the detailed two-paragraph concern you mentioned so we can capture it for recruiting and the candidate feedback.

I'll pull the consolidated scorecards into the candidate record after we close.
